rationale: The Latin anchor "cubitum" (cubit) identifies ELN as a unit of linear measurement (the ell, an 18-inch measure), and the attestations show it used to express a quantified extent (e.g., "cubitis ducentis" = 200 cubits). This aligns best with measure.n.02, which captures the sense of a quantifiable amount or extent, rather than a physical measuring instrument (measuring_stick.n.01) or the act of measuring (measurement.n.01).
